basic_details.job_title: DHS Perambalur Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 40 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District Health Society, Perambalur, under National Health Mission – Tamil Nadu (NHM-TN), is engaging 40 Staff Nurses on a contract basis that is purely temporary in nature, as per NHM norms. The posts are in the CEmONC institutions, including the SNCU and PICU, under the Directorate of Medical and Rural Health Services. Candidates need GNM or B.Sc. Nursing with valid Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council registration and must be up to 50 years of age. The filled application must reach the Office of the Executive Secretary, District Health Society, Perambalur, on or before 04.12.2026, 5:0

how_to_apply: Download the application form from the Perambalur District website, https://perambalur.nic.in.

Fill in the form (Annexure - II, Application for the post of Contractual / Temporary Staff Nurse). It asks for the applicant's details, qualification, TN Nurses and Midwives Council registration number, SSLC and HSC marks, the percentage in the qualifying exam, the district(s) applied for and community.
Attach a passport-size photo to the form and sign the declaration.
Enclose the relevant document photocopies listed below.
Send or submit the application to: The Executive Secretary / District Health Officer, Old Eye Hospital Complex, Near TNMSC, 4 Road, Thuraimangalam, Perambalur-621220.
The application must reach this address on or before 04.12.2026, 5:00 PM.
Applicants should keep self-attested photocopies of the following.
Proof of Date of Birth – Birth Certificate / SSLC / HSC Certificate.
Educational Qualification and Marks – SSLC, HSC, DGNM / B.Sc. Nursing certificate.
Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council Registration Certificate.
Proof of Tamil eligibility – 10th or 12th Standard mark sheet.
Proof of Residence – any one of Voter ID, Aadhaar Card or Ration Card.
Character and Conduct Certificate issued by a Group A or Group B Government Officer, dated within the last 3 months.
Any other certificate relevant to the applicable scoring criteria, wherever applicable.
important_instructions: The application and document photocopies must reach the DHS address by 04.12.2026, 5:00 PM. In the declaration, the applicant confirms that the Staff Nurse post is purely temporary on a contractual basis under NHM – Tamil Nadu and that the services will not be regularised for any reason. The form also asks whether the applicant is differently abled, and whether a transgender person, deserted wife, ex-serviceman or destitute widow. The notice gives the Perambalur District website, https://perambalur.nic.in/, for further information.

content_sections.heading: About NHM-TN Perambalur Recruitment
content_sections.text: The recruitment is conducted by the District Health Society, Perambalur, on behalf of National Health Mission – Tamil Nadu (NHM-TN). The Staff Nurses will work in Comprehensive Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (CEmONC) institutions, including Special Newborn Care Units (SNCU) and Paediatric Intensive Care Units (PICU), under the Directorate of Medical and Rural Health Services. The notice is signed by the Executive Secretary / District Health Officer and the Chairman / District Collector of the District Health Society, Perambalur.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 40 vacancies in the district for one post. The break-up by institution type adds up to the total: 30 + 6 + 4 = 40.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints no age cut-off date, no age relaxation and no experience requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

rows.qualification_required: GNM / B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government-approved Private Nursing College, recognized by the University approved under State Norms. Valid registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The engagement is on contract basis, purely temporary in nature, under NHM. It does not confer any right to claim regularization. Selected candidates will be placed as per G.O. (Ms.) No. 427, Health and Family Welfare (EAP-II/1) Department, dated 18.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHM-TN Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the Perambalur District website, https://perambalur.nic.in . Fill in the form (Annexure - II, Application for the post of Contractual / Temporary Staff Nurse). It asks for the applicant's details, qualification, TN Nurses and Midwives Council registration number, SSLC and HSC marks, the percentage in the qualifying exam, the district(s) applied for and community. Attach a passport-size photo to the form and sign the declaration. Enclose the relevant document photocopies listed below. Send or submit the application to: The Executive Secretary / District Health Officer, Old Eye Hospital Complex, Near TNMSC, 4 Road, Thuraimangalam, Perambalur-621220. The application must reach this address on or before 04.12.2026, 5:00 PM. Applicants should keep self-attested photocopies of the following. Proof of Date of Birth – Birth Certificate / SSLC / HSC Certificate. Educational Qualification and Marks – SSLC, HSC, DGNM / B.Sc. Nursing certificate. Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council Registration Certificate. Proof of Tamil eligibility – 10th or 12th Standard mark sheet. Proof of Residence – any one of Voter ID, Aadhaar Card or Ration Card. Character and Conduct Certificate issued by a Group A or Group B Government Officer, dated within the last 3 months. Any other certificate relevant to the applicable scoring criteria, wherever applicable. Two recent passport-size colour photographs. Community Certificate.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The application and document photocopies must reach the DHS address by 04.12.2026, 5:00 PM. In the declaration, the applicant confirms that the Staff Nurse post is purely temporary on a contractual basis under NHM – Tamil Nadu and that the services will not be regularised for any reason. The form also asks whether the applicant is differently abled, and whether a transgender person, deserted wife, ex-serviceman or destitute widow. The notice gives the Perambalur District website, https://perambalur.nic.in/ , for further information.

faq.question: Q1. How many Staff Nurse vacancies are there in NHM Perambalur?
faq.answer: There are 40 vacancies: CEmONC 30, SNCU 6 and PICU 4.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the District Health Society, Perambalur, on or before 04.12.2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: GNM / B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government-approved Private Nursing College, recognized by the University approved under State Norms, with valid registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notice gives the age as up to 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the form from https://perambalur.nic.in, fill it in and send it with document photocopies to The Executive Secretary / District Health Officer, Old Eye Hospital Complex, Near TNMSC, 4 Road, Thuraimangalam, Perambalur-621220.

faq.question: Q6. Is the Staff Nurse job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary on contract basis under NHM and does not confer any right to claim regularization.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the Staff Nurses work?
faq.answer: They will work in CEmONC institutions in Perambalur district, including the Special Newborn Care Units (SNCU) and Paediatric Intensive Care Units (PICU).

faq.question: Q8. Which documents must be attached?
faq.answer: Self-attested photocopies of proof of date of birth, SSLC, HSC and GNM / B.Sc. Nursing certificates, TN Nurses and Midwives Council registration, proof of Tamil eligibility, proof of residence, a Character and Conduct Certificate, the community certificate and two recent passport-size colour photographs.
